metrics.active_human_review_reason: No stopwatch for active human review

value.proof: Factually sound CTA and no-code example. Repeats interactive prototype without showing a reviewer action, despite E17 and captured product page.
value.consequence: Operator still has to strengthen the reason to trial before using for acquisition.

client_effort.proof: Official name, homepage, unchanged objective, automatic audience, no manually supplied facts, CTA or steering. One retry after Codex reset and one run refresh.
client_effort.consequence: Little briefing work. Quota diagnosis and retry are extra effort.

human_work.proof: Reading and verification performed. No stopwatch or manually written alternative.
human_work.consequence: Cannot quantify time saved. One concrete collaboration step and a tighter body are material editorial work.

reliability.proof: First default run rejected by Codex quota before draft. Same default recovered after stated reset. AI source check passed all 9 assertions on completed draft.
reliability.consequence: No automatic handoff or precise recovery instructions in top-level run error.

economics.proof: 11 calls for preparation; 4 for successful warm generation. 16 completed calls overall and one quota rejection.
economics.consequence: Nontrivial initial duration for a draft. Estimated dollars are instrumentation for subscription calls.

usability.proof: UI design, exact clipboard text/HTML, text download, Chrome at 390px and 1280px, sign-up page HTTP 200.
usability.consequence: Working transfer to the next tool. No sending client render exercised.

reuse.proof: Retry used stored knowledge, audience and dossier without rereading. No second distinct campaign.
reuse.consequence: Reuse works mechanically. Recurring value remains a hypothesis.
